issue.title: Run the owner-assisted on-Mac gate for Bob Mac Capture and finish the target-Mac cutover
issue.description:
Epic bob-cli-j shipped bobs-org/bob-mac-capture and retired the Hammerspoon capture workflow, but every step that needs physical Mac hardware is still unrun. All SASE agents on this epic ran on the Linux host athena, so they could not execute Swift/AppKit, codesign, or any interactive check. Proposed as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes by phase beads bob-cli-j.6 (release gate) and bob-cli-j.7 (cutover deployment); both need the same person sitting at the target Mac, so they are one task.

Automated prerequisites are now satisfied: bob-mac-capture master CI is green at f59ab74 (macOS 26, swift-format lint, swift build, swift test, bundle, plutil, codesign verify, install/reinstall).

PART 1 — release gate. Run the eight-item installed-app checklist verbatim from the 'Automated and owner-assisted release gate' section of sase/repos/plans/202608/bob_mac_capture.md (phase hardening): codesign identity/validity and authorization retention across reinstall; notification authorization display, test notification, success/failure notifications while the panel is visible, and Open Note; hotkey-to-focused-editor latency over 30+ post-login invocations across Spaces and full-screen with signpost p50 < 50 ms and p95 < 100 ms; keybindings, Unicode/emoji, IME marked text, VoiceOver, light/dark, multiple displays, secure-input recovery, hotkey collision messaging; completion/highlighting/preview parity against bob with cached route completions under 50 ms and slow/failed bob never blocking typing or losing the draft; %, %N, %header with live clipboard and Clipy history plus p:<N> preview/submit date agreement; rapid-submit at-most-once vault mutation and lossless failure handling; launch-at-login surviving logout/login with no Accessibility prompt.

PART 2 — cutover completion. Run chezmoi update -a --force on the Mac, reload Hammerspoon, install and restart Bob Mac Capture, confirm RegisterEventHotKey leaves only the app owning Control-Shift-Command-I (Hammerspoon must no longer claim it), and rerun capture, foreground-notification, clipboard, and draft-retention smoke tests. chezmoi commit 95369559 already removed the TaskCapture/WebView block, task_capture.lua, and its spec, and README.md documents rollback to revision 3d841c1e9c6dac9f558709a6ba6ef36082c2c4d4 plus the app's Control-Shift-Command-O fallback preference; the Linux host verified and deployed only its own ~/.hammerspoon tree.

Record the results. Any failure is fixed in the owning component and re-verified; rollback is the documented chezmoi restore plus turning off 'Use production Control-Shift-Command-I' in Settings.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-l — the retired agent-hood publication requests it clears are in the same bob-mac-capture outbox this task's cutover commits land in; clearing them first makes this task's own commit links resolvable.
